title: bin/ci-job runs local actions, so the lane lint reads claude-md-cites instead of unknown
why: 03:19 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed from lane rules-decisions-aligned, PR #3492). bin/ci-job cannot run the local action claude-md-cites, so the lane lint reads unknown for it; the lane lifted that with --lint-unknown-ok (reason logged by the tool). A lint of a change to the aligned check therefore never reads the claude-md-cites check. Harm it stops: a green lane lint over an unread check. Kin: step ci-job-local-action (silent-undo, a different action).
note: Queued from lane hand-in #3492. Harm: a green lane lint over an unread check (claude-md-cites).
